comparison_evidence: Surface material is a soft, porous, textured paper tissue.
Gecko dry adhesives degrade significantly on porous, textured, and fibrous surfaces, requiring higher normal force (5.5 N).
Silicone high-friction pads thrive on textured and porous surfaces through friction and local interface compliance, requiring lower normal force (2.5 N).
recommendation_summary: The silicone gripper is recommended because its high-friction elastomeric pads are well-suited for gripping soft, porous, and textured paper surfaces like a toilet paper roll. In contrast, the gecko gripper's dry-adhesive pads experience performance degradation on porous and textured materials, necessitating a higher normal force and making the silicone gripper the more efficient and robust choice for this object.
